shots.narration_span:
我现在看到 AI 回答下面带着“官方来源”四个字，第一反应已经不是放心了。

是先点开看看。
shots.staging_blocking: IP sees an AI answer carrying an official-source cue; instead of relaxing, hand moves toward source link.
shots.composition_strategy: IP face and source cue share frame; cursor/hand already points toward verification action.
shots.visual_state: Current habit is established before backstory: official source now triggers checking, not blind trust.

shots.narration_span:
因为有一次，我只是想偷个懒，查一条特别简单的退款规则。

问题也很具体：

“订单退掉以后，平台收的那笔服务费，会不会一起退回来？”
shots.staging_blocking: IP sits at cost/work desk and asks one narrowly scoped question about whether the platform service fee is refunded.
shots.composition_strategy: Question object/interface visible only enough to preserve the phrase 服务费.
shots.visual_state: The exact facet being asked—service fee—is visually anchored early.

shots.narration_span:
它搜了一下。

几秒钟以后，答案出来了：

“会。退款完成后，款项会原路退回。”

下面还真的挂着一条官方帮助中心的链接。
shots.staging_blocking: AI answer appears with a confident '会' and an official help-center source beneath it.
shots.composition_strategy: Answer conclusion is primary; source badge/link sits immediately below as trust amplifier.
shots.visual_state: Correct-looking sourcing increases confidence before any contradiction appears.

shots.narration_span:
我当时那个放心程度，大概相当于老师不仅告诉你答案，还把参考答案拍在了桌上。

于是我顺手就在成本表里写了一行：

“服务费：可退。”
shots.staging_blocking: IP relaxes, then writes 服务费：可退 into the cost sheet.
shots.composition_strategy: AI answer remains in background while cost sheet becomes foreground.
shots.visual_state: The answer changes a real working assumption; stakes become concrete.
acceptance_criteria: trust shown through behavior not narration

shots.narration_span:
本来这件事到这里已经结束了。

但我那天可能刚好手比较欠。

我点开了那个官方网页。
shots.subject_priority: IP clicks source after case seems finished
shots.staging_blocking: IP is about to move on, hesitates, then clicks the official source almost casually.
shots.composition_strategy: Cost sheet remains present; cursor moves from finished task back to source.
shots.visual_state: Investigation begins because of a small human action, not because narrator announces a lesson.

shots.narration_span:
网页没找错。

标题就是退款规则。

甚至 AI 刚才那句话，也真的能在上面找到。
shots.staging_blocking: The exact same fictional official policy page opens; title is correct and the AI-cited sentence is visibly present.
shots.composition_strategy: Stable page layout established: title upper area; two policy lines stacked below.
shots.visual_state: The source is genuinely correct/relevant, blocking the easy explanation 'wrong page'.

shots.narration_span:
上面写着：

“退款完成后，订单款项将退回原支付方式。”
shots.staging_blocking: IP reads the first line stating the order payment returns to original method.
shots.framing_strategy: tight insert on first line within stable page layout
shots.composition_strategy: First line highlighted; second line remains below but not yet focal.
shots.visual_state: This is the true sentence the AI overgeneralized from.
acceptance_criteria: do not reveal second line as dominant yet

shots.narration_span:
我往下又看了一行。

“平台服务费不予退还。”
shots.subject_priority: second policy line: service fee not refunded
shots.staging_blocking: IP gaze moves one line down; the service-fee exception becomes the new focal point.
shots.framing_strategy: matched insert, same page position shifted downward
shots.composition_strategy: Second line highlighted in same page; first line now de-emphasized but still spatially nearby.
shots.visual_state: Contradiction is discovered through eye movement on the same correct source.
acceptance_criteria: 平台服务费不予退还 dominant

shots.narration_span:
……

我又看了一眼 AI 的答案。

“会。”

再看网页。

“不予退还。”
shots.staging_blocking: IP freezes, then alternates gaze between the AI answer and the official source line.
shots.framing_strategy: matched contrast: answer pane ↔ source line ↔ reaction
shots.composition_strategy: Keep '会' and '不予退还' in stable matched focal positions to make contradiction effortless to read.
shots.visual_state: The story's central Gap becomes visible without explanation.

shots.narration_span:
这时候最奇怪的地方就出现了。

它不是没联网。

也不是搜到了什么野鸡论坛。

它甚至把正确的官网放在了我面前。

但它拿着回答“订单款项去哪儿”的那句话，回答了我“服务费退不退”的问题。
shots.staging_blocking: IP checks three possibilities in the same investigation: web access exists, source is official, page is correct; then points back to mismatch between question and cited sentence.
shots.framing_strategy: medium desk + evidence objects, not a diagram
shots.composition_strategy: Official page and question remain co-present; eliminated explanations visually recede.
shots.visual_state: Error is localized away from retrieval/source identity and toward evidence-question alignment.

shots.narration_span: 但它拿着回答“订单款项去哪儿”的那句话，回答了我“服务费退不退”的问题。
shots.staging_blocking: One matched evidence frame puts 服务费 from the question beside 订单款项 from the cited line without pretending they are the same phrase.
shots.framing_strategy: minimal matched insert in story context
shots.composition_strategy: Two short phrases occupy comparable positions with different surrounding context.
shots.visual_state: The exact semantic mismatch becomes visible.
acceptance_criteria: phrases remain sourced from story objects

shots.narration_span:
就像我问一个人：

“老板今天来不来？”

他翻开通讯录，准确找到了老板那一页，然后特别自信地告诉我：

“老板电话是 138……”

资料没找错。

答案还是没回答问题。
shots.staging_blocking: A compact associative analogy: question asks whether boss comes today; person opens correct boss contact page and answers with phone number.
shots.framing_strategy: 2–3 state associative montage, visually distinct but brief
shots.composition_strategy: Keep same IP-like storyteller logic; do not build a separate elaborate universe.
shots.visual_state: Correct record + wrong facet becomes intuitive.
acceptance_criteria: 老板电话 not treated as real personal data

shots.narration_span:
我后来又试了一次。

这次没问它“答案是什么”。

我只问：

“你引用的网页里，哪一句话明确说明服务费会退？”
shots.staging_blocking: Back at the same desk, IP asks not for the answer but for the exact sentence that explicitly says the service fee will be refunded.
shots.composition_strategy: New question emphasizes 哪一句 and 服务费 while official page remains available.
shots.visual_state: Strategy changes from conclusion-seeking to evidence-seeking.

shots.narration_span:
它重新看了一遍。

然后答案变了。
shots.staging_blocking: AI answer pane changes after re-examining the same official page; IP sees the conclusion reverse.
shots.composition_strategy: Same interface geometry, changed conclusion state.
shots.visual_state: The new verification strategy produces a different conclusion without changing the source page.

shots.narration_span:
因为“搜到网页”和“用对网页里的证据”，其实是两件事。

搜索做的，是把可能有用的资料拿回来。
shots.staging_blocking: IP places the same official page on the desk, then traces from page to the particular sentence actually supporting the question.
shots.composition_strategy: Page is one object; selected evidence is a smaller focal region inside it.
shots.visual_state: '找回来' and '用对证据' are differentiated through scale of attention, not boxes.

shots.narration_span:
但资料回来以后，模型还得判断：

哪一句跟你的问题真正对应。

哪些只是看起来很像。

有没有例外。

几句话放在一起以后，结论到底是什么。
shots.staging_blocking: A compact evidence-reading sequence shows four concerns inside the same page/question workspace: correspondence, misleading similarity, exception, combined conclusion.
shots.framing_strategy: one coherent investigation montage, not one card per clause
shots.composition_strategy: Question and page stay fixed; highlight/focal relation changes only when meaning changes.
shots.visual_state: Generation still needs to use evidence correctly after retrieval.
acceptance_criteria: no claim model literally reads linearly
all four concerns can share 2–3 beats later

shots.narration_span:
这一步如果错了，就会出现一种特别有迷惑性的答案：

来源是真的。

链接也是真的。

甚至引用的句子也是真的。

只有最后那个结论，是错的。
shots.staging_blocking: Same answer package is deconstructed: source valid, link valid, quote valid—yet conclusion mismatches the question.
shots.composition_strategy: Keep one answer package on screen; validation marks accumulate around components, then final conclusion remains isolated as wrong.
shots.visual_state: The dangerous error feels trustworthy because many surrounding components are real.

shots.narration_span:
所以现在我看 AI 搜索结果，已经不太把“有引用”当成正确证明了。

如果答案不重要，我当然也不会每次都去查。

但如果这件事真的会让我花钱、改方案，或者做一个很难撤回来的决定，

我会多问一句：

“这个来源里的哪句话，真的支持你的结论？”
shots.subject_priority: new verification rule with risk boundary
shots.staging_blocking: IP uses ordinary AI answers casually, but for money/plan/irreversible decisions pauses and asks which exact source sentence supports the conclusion.
shots.framing_strategy: medium action contrast at same desk
shots.composition_strategy: Low-stakes state passes; high-stakes state stops at verification action.
shots.visual_state: Method remains proportional rather than turning into 'verify everything'.

shots.narration_span:
因为 AI 搜索最容易让我放松警惕的地方，可能恰恰就是——

它真的给我找对了网页。
shots.staging_blocking: Return to the original official-source cue; this time IP clicks it before accepting the answer.
shots.composition_strategy: Opening frame is echoed, but behavior has changed.
shots.visual_state: Final meaning is proven by changed behavior: the correct webpage can still require evidence checking.
